Memory Type: 1866/1600/1333MHz Unbuffered non-ECC SO-DIMM DDR3L, 204-pin gold-plated DIMMs

Network Controllers: Dual GbE LAN with Intel i210-IT controller

COM Port: 2 RS232, 2 RS232/422/485, RS-485 supports auto flow control

PCI-Express: 1 M.2 2280 B-Key for SATA or PCIe SSD (2242 can be supported with bracket)

Power Configurations: Control of power-on for recovery from AC power loss
CPU thermal trip support for processor protection

Operating Temperature: -20°C to 60°C (-4°F to 140°F) with 0.7 m/s air flow
Non-operating Relative Humidity: 5% to 95% (non-condensing) The use of industrial grade wide-temperature peripherals is required to meet 60°C operating temperature.
